relationships.subject: miR-3584-5p
relationships.evidence_quote: MiR-3584-5p indirectly inhibited the expression of Nav1.8 by up-regulating the expression of key proteins in the ERK5/CREB signaling pathway

relationships.subject: miR-3584-5p
relationships.evidence_quote: also inhibited the current density of the Nav1.8 channel, changed its channel dynamics characteristic

relationships.subject: miR-3584-5p
relationships.evidence_quote: over-expression of miR-3584-5p aggravated neuronal injury by hematoxylin-eosin (H&E) staining and mechanical/thermal hypersensitivity in CCI rats

relationships.subject: miR-3584-5p
relationships.evidence_quote: decreased the ratio of apoptosis-related factor Bcl-2/Bax, and thus promoted neuronal apoptosis

key_findings: miR-3584-5p over-expression aggravates CCI neuropathic pain in rats and reduces Nav1.8 expression and current density.
miR-3584-5p acts through the ERK5/CREB pathway and promotes apoptosis via the mitochondrial pathway.
